description: Write a small x86-64 Linux assembly function (GNU as, System V AMD64 ABI) that C code can call, from a short specification.
input_format: A short spec naming the function, its exact C prototype and its behaviour, including edge cases.
output_format: GNU as source for x86-64 (Intel syntax via .intel_syntax noprefix, or AT&T) with a .globl symbol per requested function, no main, no libc calls.
eval_criteria: The code assembles, links with the example's C tests and passes them.

seed_examples.input: Implement `long sum_array(const long *a, long n)` returning the sum of n 64-bit integers; 0 when n is 0.
seed_examples.output:
.intel_syntax noprefix
    .text
    .globl sum_array
sum_array:
    xor eax, eax
    test rsi, rsi
    jle 2f
1:
    add rax, [rdi]
    add rdi, 8
    dec rsi
    jnz 1b
2:
    ret

seed_examples.input: Implement `unsigned long my_strlen(const char *s)` returning the length of a NUL-terminated string.
seed_examples.output:
.intel_syntax noprefix
    .text
    .globl my_strlen
my_strlen:
    mov rax, rdi
1:
    cmp byte ptr [rax], 0
    je 2f
    inc rax
    jmp 1b
2:
    sub rax, rdi
    ret

seed_examples.input: Implement `long max3(long a, long b, long c)` returning the largest of three signed 64-bit integers, without branches.
seed_examples.output:
.intel_syntax noprefix
    .text
    .globl max3
max3:
    mov rax, rdi
    cmp rax, rsi
    cmovl rax, rsi
    cmp rax, rdx
    cmovl rax, rdx
    ret

seed_examples.input: Implement `void to_upper(char *s)` that converts ASCII a-z to A-Z in place in a NUL-terminated string, leaving every other byte unchanged.
seed_examples.output:
.intel_syntax noprefix
    .text
    .globl to_upper
to_upper:
1:
    mov al, [rdi]
    test al, al
    je 3f
    lea ecx, [rax - 'a']
    cmp cl, 25
    ja 2f
    sub al, 32
    mov [rdi], al
2:
    inc rdi
    jmp 1b
3:
    ret

seed_examples.input: Implement `unsigned long gcd(unsigned long a, unsigned long b)` with Euclid's algorithm; gcd(0, b) is b.
seed_examples.output:
.intel_syntax noprefix
    .text
    .globl gcd
gcd:
    mov rax, rdi
1:
    test rsi, rsi
    je 2f
    xor edx, edx
    div rsi
    mov rax, rsi
    mov rsi, rdx
    jmp 1b
2:
    ret
